program.section_heading: ASSOCIATE DEGREE: ART HISTORY Associate of Arts Degree (AA) (Program Code 100200, State Code 02961)
program.ge_pattern: Any GE (LACCD GE Plan or Cal-GETC)
outcomes: Identify and describe, using appropriate vocabulary, visual examples of artworks' characteristics from a variety of western and non-western cultures and periods.
Correlate how production and use of artworks are influenced by social, political, economic, and other cultural factors of a variety of western and non-western cultures and periods.
Identify and analyze, in a non-ethnocentric way, various common factors that motivate production and use of art in a multi-cultural perspective.
Analyze and describe elements of composition in visual art and architecture from a variety of western and non-western cultures in a non-ethnocentric frame of reference.

LIST B: COMPLETE 2 COURSES FROM THE FOLLOWING

notes: Read the AA section (State Code 02961) on page 52, not the AA-T (State Code 32117) on page 51.
List B ends with 'Or any course not used in List A.' — any unused List A course (ARTH C1100, ARTH C1200, ART 115) may also count toward List B.
Catalog prints ART 093 / ART 094 and ARTH C1100 / ARTH C1200; matched to closed-list ART 93 / ART 94 and ARTHC1100 / ARTHC1200.

Description says ART 201 is strongly recommended for students transferring to UC Berkeley or UC Merced, and ART 103 for students who want to teach at the elementary education level; both already appear in List B, so no separate recommended block was created.
'Total Minimum Units: 60' printed in the section recorded as degree_total; Major Units 18 as total_units. GE units not printed in the section.
ge_pattern taken from the program table on page 51 ('Any GE^': LACCD GE Plan or Cal-GETC), not from the AA section itself.
Careers: description mentions 'entry level careers in art history and related industries'; recorded 'art history' only. It also mentions students who want to teach at the elementary education level.
The AA heading prints Program Code 100200, the same code as the Studio Arts AA-T; reviewer may verify.
